title: Meta Launches Muse Glimmer and Zuckerberg Outlines AI Vision
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weights model for local agentic workflows.
- Mark Zuckerberg published a manifesto advocating for open-source AI and personal agents.
- OpenAI launched a new cyber-trained model to bolster its Daybreak defense program.
- Wall Street firms are organizing a $500 billion funding package for AI infrastructure.

Meta dominated the AI landscape with the release of Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter model designed for local, always-on agentic workflows. Alongside this launch, CEO Mark Zuckerberg released a 6,500-word manifesto promoting open-source technology as a safeguard against the concentration of power. His vision emphasizes the development of personal AI agents, supported by a $1 billion pledge to communities hosting the necessary data centers.

Meanwhile, OpenAI is focusing on security, launching a new cyber-trained model to expand its Daybreak defense program amid rising AI-led attacks. Despite these advancements, the industry faces mounting pressure regarding AI safety, with Senator Bernie Sanders calling for a pause in development. Financial backing for the sector remains robust, as investment firms move to assemble a $500 billion funding package to support Nvidia-reliant AI infrastructure.
